notes.title: Patch 5 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed the engine version, No longer can run in Debug mode
Fixed an issue where one of the Leviathans couldn't spawn
Fixed an issue where upgrades wouldn't unequip

notes.title: Patch 4 - Initial Performance Tweaks and Bugfixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Initial performance enhancements, Optimized the base ship class to use fewer physics rays for pathfinding. Each ship is now setup in one of 5 buckets, only one bucket is executed each physics step so performance should be much better with more ships as only 1/5th of the ships are being simulated each step as before
[*]Fixed a bug where the galaxy map would be shown on initial load instead of the start menu causing some buttons to not be clickable unless you backed out and returned
[*]Fixed a bug where music tracks would overlap each other
[/list]

notes.title: Progression Overhaul
notes.content:
[h2]Progression Overhaul[/h2]
With this update progression has been completely overhauled. Previously progression was tied to the "Cycle" number which was a little abstract. The cycle count has now been replaced with a cluster map. This map represents the progress of the entire game, as you venture further outward the difficulty and rewards will increase. Difficulty and rewards have also been overhauled, progression now happens much faster so enemies will become noticeably more difficulty and the rewards gained at the end of each galaxy will be much more powerful as well. You will also unlock new ships and new tech as you defeat galaxies. 6 new ships have been added and 6 new tech have been added to unlock

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478801/f289b7902213139d016fae905f10e4342588d4b1.png[/img]

Unfortunately, as a part of this update previously unlocked cycles will be reset however you will retain all unlocked starting ships

There is an option in settings to delete your save state for anyone who would like to start from the beginning 

[h3]Other Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a performance issue with skipping the tutorial
[*]Fixed a bug where upgrades on capital ship were not calculated correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where 2 techs shared behavior
[*]Fixed a bug where the damage on support ships was being rounded to an int instead of a float
[*]Adjusted enemy capital ship hitpoints
[*]Fixed an memory reference issue where ship unlocks would be duplicated 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3 - Adjusted progression and difficulty
notes.content:
[list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[*]Reduced flat damage gained from tech
[*]Reduced Missile damage
[*]Merchant now spawns further away from the starting planet
[*]Reduced Drone explosion radius
[*]Adjusted ship level scaling to make ships much more difficult as you progress cycles
[*]Adjusted starter ship reward scaling so reward ships are more powerful as you progress cycles
10% stat increase per cycle -> 20% stat increase per cycle

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[*]Fixed an issue with RMB battle camera movement
[*]Fixed a bug/crash where drones wouldn't heal from repair ship
[*]Fixed an issue where resetting upgrades would reset all stats to 0 instead of starting level
[*]Fixed a bug where hitting escape in the pause menu would start the battle before the "Start" button was pressed
[*]Fixed a bug where "Increase Fleet Capacity" cost would not reset its cost between games
[*]Fixed a bug where game could crash when changing ship behavior after battle ended

[h3]UI[/h3]
[*]Added a plus sign to per turn resources for consistency
[/list]

notes.title: Armada: Last Light is now available!
notes.content:
Armada: Last Light is now available! I hope you enjoy the game. I'm excited to get feedback on areas to continue development. I already have some ideas which I hope to release in the upcoming months!

Thanks to everyone who has supported it this far.

Good luck commanders!
